name: 22742-visionarena-72b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, ONE node. The item needs all eight GPUs in one allocation.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine on one node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), 1024 streams, one point in one engine session, bounded at 4000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 30% by completion -- 1200 requests, so the whole 1024-request opening burst is spent before the measured window opens.
workload: Real image+text chat, one image and one turn per request. `merve/vqav2-small`, split `validation`, 21435 rows, through the `huggingface` deserializer with its default column mapping -- `question` becomes the text, `image` becomes the image. Output length is pinned: `max_tokens: 128` with `ignore_eos: true`.
purpose: A photo question-answering chat assistant on a 72B model, handling 1024 concurrent single-image questions across eight GPUs.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 8
trust-remote-code: true
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
max-model-len: 8192
# What `vllm serve` picks for itself on a >=70 GiB non-A100 device, written down because this
# harness builds the engine in-process and never reaches that defaulting path.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
